briefs.62db46b60f1c209603228613971943d1: Supported a two-year freeze on draught beer excise under the Excise Tariff Amendment (Draught Beer) Bill 2025 and associated bill, presenting it as cost-of-living relief and support for pubs, clubs, breweries, jobs and community organisations. The proceeding also considered amendments on spirits and other alcohol taxes, with the government opposing them.
briefs.f189883e0b2d6c8d2a90274ce39b9712: The Prime Minister argued for the National Reconstruction Fund to boost Australian manufacturing, jobs, and economic sovereignty, citing the Clean Energy Finance Corporation’s success in unlocking $2.60 in private investment per dollar and listing seven priority areas including renewables, medical science, and defence.
